title: Chromosome replication state across the cell cycle
caption: oriC count (1->2->4) and replication-fork positions vs time, both seeds.
interpretation: The red step trace shows the number of replication origins rising 1->2->4 at initiation events while blue points show replication-fork positions sweeping from oriC toward terC; division resets the state. The regular oriC-doubling and fork sweeps in both seeds confirm coordinated, once-per-cell-cycle replication initiation.
simulations: 2-seed x 2-gen wild-type baseline ensemble (showcase2-baseline-full), Ray-parallel, XArray/zarr + parquet emit.
